content.text:
Finding submitted.

**AUDIT — deviation (Section 22.1).** The clause allowed unlimited, unannounced audits with remote access to our systems — walk-away territory and short of even the fallback. Sections 22.2/22.3 already deliver two preferred elements verbatim (Vendor bears costs unless underpayment exceeds five percent; no direct access to Customer systems), so I targeted preferred with a single replacement of the offending sentence adding the once-per-12-months cap, 30 days' written notice, business hours, off-site-where-possible and independent confidentiality-bound auditor limbs, while deleting the remote-access permission that contradicted 22.2.
